text:
micah: Hey team — need help coordinating merge timing for PR #12540. CI queue is super long (lots of nightly jobs) and we have the deploy freeze starting next Monday. Change is small but an e2e flake keeps failing. Can we get a rebase window or an alternate plan? cc @sasha @lee

ci-bot: CI queue position: 72. Estimated job start ~3h from now. Last run failed on: e2e::checkout-test (intermittent flake). Rerun: `./scripts/ci/rerun_pr.sh 12540`

jordan: If the diff is small could we land a small hotfix first and follow up with the bigger refactor after the freeze? That avoids blocking.

micah: hotfix is feasible, but the refactor touches infra wiring; need approvals + smoke run. Not sure we can split cleanly.

sasha: I can eyeball and run a quick smoke locally. If it passes I'll approve and help queue it in canary. micah — send me the minimal repro steps or a short runbook.

micah: repro: checkout branch, `make smoke` (takes ~4m), then `./bin/integration --target checkout-test`. I'll paste the tiny patch below.

micah: ```diff
- handleLegacy()
+ handleLegacyCompat()
```

lee: We have a rebase window Tue 10:00-11:00 PT (team agreed) but that might be after the freeze starts. ops-bot — is there any flexibility on the freeze start?

ops-bot: Scheduled deploy freeze: starts 2026-03-23T00:00:00Z and ends 2026-03-30T00:00:00Z. Exceptions allowed for security or critical fixes via oncall approval.

jordan: If it's not security, we need canary + manual approval before freeze. Could we target a canary run tonight (off-hours) to avoid queue pressure tomorrow?

ci-bot: Nightly windows have lower concurrency but some jobs still queue. You can set `CI_PRIORITY=high` for a single rerun: `CI_PRIORITY=high ./scripts/ci/rerun_pr.sh 12540` — note this consumes burst quota.

qa-team: We can take the smoke run right now and share results. micah — I'll need branch name and any env vars.

micah: branch `micah/12540-compat`. ENV: `FEATURE_FLAG_LEGACY=1`. Thanks @qa-team and @sasha.

sasha: Running smoke now locally. If green, I'll push approval and ping for a high-priority rerun.

micah: Ok starting a quick rebase to clean conflicts before smoke. Command: `git pull --rebase origin main && git push -f`

sasha: smoke passed locally. no obvious regressions. leaving an approval. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll coordinate the high-priority rerun and watch logs. micah — once CI is green can you post the `build_url` here so SRE can gate canary?

ci-bot: Rerun started (CI_PRIORITY=high). Build: https://ci.internal/builds/12540/3

micah: build looks green so far. link above. tagging @eng-oncall for canary rollout.

lee: SRE, can we do canary deploy for just this service tonight? If yes, schedule window and rollback plan.

ops-bot: Eng-oncall paged for canary approval. Use `ops-approve --ticket=PR-12540` to record exception if needed.

micah: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the canary results. If anything flakes again we'll revert and plan the big refactor post-freeze. Appreciated the quick eyes.

jordan: Thanks micah — great choreography.

qa-team: Canary smoke passed post-deploy. No user-facing errors observed.

micah: marking this resolved for now, will reopen if any regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
